question: Where are a golf course located no farther than 180 kilometers toward the southeast of Speert Green, Wayne, NJ?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin( geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), 180000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
